what: Several panels are stacked in one spot and, from 3s on, only the next panel is turned on every 10s. The lit panel flies from the start (horizontal −30%) to the end (−150% − 200px) in 6s straight (linear) and is visible, while the off panel returns to place without being seen. Each time one turns on, the stage (data-fx-part=open) gets is-open for 3 seconds (the window opens) and only on the Skin where the rider template (rider — flapping bird etc.) is on. Dot buttons mark the current slide (with tap: 1, pressing one jumps straight to that slide), and paging locks for .5s

options.every: Interval before flipping to the next board (s), default 10
options.fly: Flight duration (seconds), default 6 (original phone 3) — also settable via css --fx-fly
options.open: Seconds to keep is-open on the stage, default 3
options.lock: Cooldown before another swipe is allowed (sec), default .5
options.tap: If 0, pressing a dot button doesn’t move on and only shows the current panel (in the original the dots are display only). Default 1

use:
Window
Cover 1
Cover 2
note: Start and end positions are changed with the css variables --fx-from and --fx-to (transform values). The reference box of the plate is set by the consumer (the original starts at left 100% inside a box of the left half of the screen + 54px width). With reduce it does not start.

from.where: index.html .yv-fv (in the window house a cover is dragged off by a bird — after 3s every 10s, flight 6s linear (phone 3s), window opens 3s)
